text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Sonnet
text: Terra's confirmed, so I should spend tonight hunting the hidden one instead of wasting it.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Night falls on Palermo. A new day dawns in Palermo without Sonnet. Sonnet's card stays face down.

text: Palermo has voted: Gemma is out. Gemma shows the card: citizen.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the officer, Haiku the doctor, Gemma the citizen, Sol the citizen, Luna the killer, Terra the killer.

Sonnet, the officer, opened Day 1 by naming Terra on a gut feeling, and Haiku, the doctor, spent the day pressing Luna to pick a target. The town voted Haiku out, which left no doctor to protect anyone. Sonnet was killed that night, so Day 2 had no officer to check the killers. Gemma went after Luna while Terra backed her up, and the town voted Gemma out, leaving Sol as the only citizen against two killers. Luna and Terra won.
